premises: Thermal annealing induces short-range chemical ordering (SRO) in multi-component FCC alloys like CrCoNi.
SRO creates nanoscale spatial fluctuations in local stacking fault energy (SFE).
SFE fluctuations impede dislocation motion by acting as energy barriers.
